misconceptions.issue: Thinking that people who came to India from outside are 'foreigners' even today.
misconceptions.remediation: Explain that over centuries, these groups became an inseparable part of India. Their descendants are as much Indian as anyone else. (समझाएं कि सदियों से, ये समूह भारत का एक अविभाज्य हिस्सा बन गए। उनके वंशज उतने ही भारतीय हैं जितने कोई और।)

misconceptions.issue: Assuming that diversity makes a country weak.
misconceptions.remediation: Highlight that diversity is India's unique strength, leading to a rich culture and many different talents working together. (इस बात पर प्रकाश डालें कि विविधता भारत की अनूठी ताकत है, जिससे एक समृद्ध संस्कृति और एक साथ काम करने वाली कई अलग-अलग प्रतिभाएँ पैदा होती हैं।)
